name: plugin-dev
description: Toolkit for building Caeros plugins: scaffolding, manifest schema reference, and publishing guides.

interface.shortDescription: Build and publish Caeros plugins: scaffolding, manifest reference, marketplace guide.
interface.longDescription: Everything needed to author Caeros plugins. The create-caeros-plugin skill is the authoritative reference for plugin structure: directory layout, the full plugin.json manifest schema (capabilities, permissions, runtime, interface), skills and slash-command conventions, MCP server bundling via .mcp.json, and compatibility with other plugin bundle formats. The publish-caeros-plugin skill covers shipping: git-repo marketplaces, the caeros-official marketplace, and the hosted registry. The /new-plugin command scaffolds a working plugin from a one-line description.
